digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud <-> Data Center adapter reconciler
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) has incident-hardened byte-for-byte characterization and ADF depth tests, while Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) has multi-page pagination and TLS validation coverage that Cloud lacks, creating bidirectional test-parity gaps
Data Center adapter's whole-project readers have never been tested past one page while Cloud's pagination is untested, representing the highest-risk coverage gap

The duplicated ticket-type map literal exists in multiple places within adapters/ and must be single-sourced before it can be guarded by the same anti-regression mechanism already applied to status and priority maps
Data Center's create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, and probe branches are not pinned by value, only by shape, leaving actual contract values unverified in production
Data Center comment and description length convergence across multiple passes, and the provenance of the comment ceiling constant, are not documented or tested
Five enumerated vacuous tests in the suite lack meaningful assertions and do not validate the contracts their docstrings claim to cover
